description: Create a new view in Zendesk. Views are saved ticket filters that help agents organize and prioritize their work. They can filter tickets by conditions like status, priority, assignee, and more. Use this action when you need to: - Create a custom view for a specific team or workflow - Set up views for different ticket priorities or statuses - Create views with restricted access for specific groups - Configure views with specific columns, grouping, and sort order Note: At minimum, the 'all' conditions must include a condition checking 'status', 'type', 'group_id', 'assignee_id', or 'requester_id'.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for creating a Zendesk view.

active.description: Whether the view is active and visible to agents. Set to false to save as a draft.
active.human_parameter_description: Whether the view is visible to agents. Set to false to create a draft view that won't appear in their list.
active.title: Active

conditions.description: The conditions that define which tickets appear in the view. 'all' conditions must ALL be true; 'any' conditions allow OR logic. At least one 'all' condition is required.
conditions.human_parameter_description: Define which tickets appear in the view. 'All' conditions must ALL match; 'any' allows OR logic. At least one 'all' condition is required.

items.description: A single condition item for view conditions (all/any arrays).

field.description: The field to check in the condition. Common fields: 'status', 'type', 'priority', 'assignee_id', 'group_id', 'requester_id', 'organization_id', 'tags', 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'channel', 'is_public', 'via_id', 'locale_id'.
